steps.title: Analyze Simple Clicker configuration files and logic structure
steps.description: Examine the layout, build configurations, and MainActivity java classes to isolate logic issues with high score milestone displays and clean up unnecessary third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Review dependency configuration within app build file
steps.description: Verify external dependencies inside build.gradle and align with clean Android SDK instructions by removing the nanohttpd library.

steps.title: Clean up unauthorized implementation lines
steps.description: Remove the custom nanohttpd implementation from dependencies list to fulfill strict standard-library-only execution rules.

steps.title: Trace MainActivity high score milestone comparison flow
steps.description: Diagnose the logical race condition where high scores were committed and matched before the rendering cycle occurred, bypassing the 'NEW HIGH SCORE' celebration overlay.

steps.title: Redesign renderMetrics high score flag detection
steps.description: Refactor renderMetrics to dynamically determine if the current counter is strictly greater than the previously saved persistent high score, and toggle a stateful boolean.

steps.title: Verify automatic state synchronization inside click events
steps.description: Delegate metric commits directly inside renderMetrics state-updating steps rather than separate preemptive block calls inside the button listeners.

steps.title: Update UI state rendering flags and colors
steps.description: Re-enable mint-green achievements text rendering upon earning authentic new custom high scores, while reserving light blue and orange banners for match-point ties and near-miss milestones.

steps.title: Confirm proper SharedPreferences key storage routines
steps.description: Verify that custom counters, step preferences, and haptic options save reliably when updating high score records.

steps.title: Verify portrait configuration attributes and manifest orientation
steps.description: Inspect AndroidManifest.xml package paths and activities to avoid runtime configuration errors on target Android 34 devices.

steps.title: Validate resources and XML design guidelines
steps.description: Scan chip states, cards backgrounds, and button designs to ensure smooth vector representation without asset faults.

steps.title: Compile codebase with Standard Java 17 Compatibility
steps.description: Run standard Gradle assembly scripts to confirm standard Java 8 source compilation without external annotation anomalies.

steps.title: Building Simple Clicker
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to finalize project optimization and build the complete app package smoothly.
